name: Green Goddess Cobb Salad with Spinach, Bacon, Egg & Blue Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain eggs and transfer to a medium bowl; add ice or run under cold water to cool. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg chives
1 small bunch cilantro
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ avocados
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Roughly chop chives and add to the blender.
Shave cilantro and parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.

Add yogurt, oil, water, capers, and spices to the blender. Blend on high until almost smooth, adding additional water, 1-2 tablespoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tbsp capers
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and place on a large plate.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the tomatoes.
When the eggs are done, wipe the pot clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the bacon is cooking, peel and quarter eggs.
Divide spinach between plates or bowls; top with eggs, tomatoes, avocado, bacon, and blue cheese. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
